title: Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2610.17824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a principal recipe for improving the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). It rests on the assumption that the checker scoring each response is itself correct. In practice, rule-based checkers reject correct answers in unexpected formats, unit tests accept incorrect programs, and LLM judges can be led to approve empty or adversarial responses. This work surveys 58 studies that measure, analyze, or mitigate such verifier errors. We ask what errors verifiers make, how they affect training, which mitigations work against which errors, and how the findings extend to self-generated, rubric- and judge-based, and verifier-free rewards. The evidence suggests that the structure of an error matters more than its rate. Random errors mostly slow learning, though under a fixed budget or KL regularization they also lower final accuracy. translated_title: 检验检查器：RLVR中验证器噪声与鲁棒性的综述
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的主要方法，其建立在一个假设之上：对每个回答进行打分的检查器本身是正确的。然而在实践中，基于规则的检查器会拒绝格式不符合预期的正确答案，单元测试会接受错误的程序，而LLM裁判可能被引导去批准空洞或对抗性的回答。本工作综述了58项测量、分析或缓解此类验证器错误的研究。我们探讨验证器会犯哪些错误、这些错误如何影响训练、哪些缓解措施对哪些错误有效，以及这些发现如何扩展到自生成奖励、基于评分标准和裁判的奖励以及无验证器奖励。证据表明，错误的结构比其发生率更重要。随机错误主要会减慢学习速度，但在固定预算或KL正则化条件下，它们也会降低最终准确率。策略能够学会利用的假阳性错误……
tldr: 本文综述了58项关于RLVR中验证器错误的研究，发现错误的结构比错误率更为关键，并系统梳理了验证器错误的类型、其对训练的影响以及相应的缓解策略。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys 58 studies on verifier errors in RLVR, revealing that the structure of errors matters more than their rate, and systematically examines error types, their impact on training, and effective mitigation strategies.
